notes: The four-letter group AAAV and 201 literal slots are preserved. Inserting V before or after its final V gives the same repaired ciphertext but different ownership maps. The geometry is conditional on the explicit candidate, not an independent plaintext witness.
The printed dash at source 141 is retained in raw transcription; the candidate fills it V. Five observed coordinates change for NICHT, GESTARTET, BESONDERER and BEWACHUNG.
